_comment: Testnet values verified on Monad testnet (chain 10143) on 2026-10-11: underlying = WETH 0x4547…A2D7 (18 decimals, monad-crypto token list); asset = USDC 0x534b…43A3 (6 decimals, Circle testnet address); settlement feed = Chainlink ETH/USD 0x5c8c…6d31 and quote feed = Chainlink USDC/USD 0x3982…Ff95 (8 decimals each, 24 h heartbeats, so maxLegSkew is 28 h). Kuru stays disabled on testnet. ETH/USDC listing for monad-testnet (DEPLOYMENT.md §3; values from PARAMETERS.md). Read by script/ProposeListing.s.sol (LISTING=eth-usdc), which refuses zero addresses: fill in the WETH and USDC token addresses, the Chainlink-compatible ETH/USD and USDC/USD settlement feeds (and their decimals), and the publisher addresses before proposing. Pyth feed ids are Pyth's ETH/USD and USDC/USD (checked against Hermes 2026-10-07). maxLegSkew must cover the slower leg's heartbeat. insuranceSeed and keeperReserveMin come from the risk review (PARAMETERS.md §7) and must be non-zero. Amounts are in USDC's 6 decimals; strikes and caps in 1e18. ZERO-USDC LAUNCH: bootstrapFromFees = true lists with insuranceSeed and keeperReserveMin at 0 (no treasury deposits); insurance then fills from 60% and the keeper reserve from 10% of every fee. Until it has grown, a writer shortfall at expiry falls on that group's holders through the recovery ratio and keepers earn no USDC reward, so keep the short cap low and run the keepers yourself.
